flows.name: Refine a prompt in Gemini
flows.description: User drafts a prompt, the extension rewrites it with persona memory, user reviews the diff and sends.

steps.desc: User types a draft prompt into the Gemini composer; observer has already located the input element.
Refine toggle and settings icon are mounted into the composer container.
User clicks the Refine toggle (or presses Ctrl+Shift+R, which arrives as TRIGGER_REFINE_SHORTCUT).
Sends REFINE_PROMPT with the draft text, persona, prior prompts, template and model id.
Registers an AbortController for the tab, cancelling any in-flight refinement, then reads pa_models and pa_active_model.
Decrypts the stored API key if it is in encrypted form.
Loads the session's memory; a pinned persona takes precedence over the synthesized one, with globalPersona as final fallback.
Assembles the 7 dimensions into the refinement context block.
POSTs the refinement request to the active provider endpoint with the abort signal attached.
Returns the refined text, or a user-friendly message on failure.
Computes the word-level diff between original and refined text and renders the review modal.
User accepts; refined text replaces the composer contents.
Fires Gemini's native send so the refined prompt is submitted.

flows.name: Build persona memory from a conversation
flows.description: The extension scrapes the conversation and derives all 7 persona dimensions in a single LLM call.

steps.desc: User presses Rebuild Memory in the Context tab footer (or analysis auto-triggers on activity).
Panel asks the worker to rebuild memory for the current session.
Worker relays REBUILD_MEMORY_REQUEST into the MAIN-world memory orchestrator.
Guards against concurrent runs by reusing the in-flight analysis promise.
Reads the conversation turns; aborts early if there is no history.
Collects pinned dimensions so they are excluded from re-analysis and preserved verbatim.
One LLM call produces all 7 dimensions plus suggested_name/suggested_title metadata.
Request goes out through the configured provider; MAIN world proxies it via the bridge.
Each returned dimension is validated against its V4 schema, sanitized and stored.
MAIN world has no chrome.* access, so persistence is proxied by CustomEvent pa-storage-request.
The ISOLATED-world bridge performs the actual write and replies on pa-storage-response.
Context tab re-renders the 7 accordions with fresh counts and the updated timestamp.

flows.name: Extract a persona from a pasted prompt
flows.description: User pastes any prompt and the extension converts it into a structured, editable persona.

steps.desc: User opens Persona tab and taps the + FAB to reach the Create page.
User pastes a prompt, or imports a .json/.txt/.xml/.md file via #import-persona-file.
User presses Extract Persona in the footer.
Rejects prompts under 10 characters, then proceeds.
Requests the active provider/model config via GET_MODEL_CONFIG.
Sends the extraction prompt to the provider with an abort signal.
Strips ```json fences and validates that memory_layer and metadata are both present.
Result is persisted to persona_drafts so the edit survives a panel reload.
Edit Persona page opens pre-filled with the 7 dimensions and metadata.

flows.name: Publish a persona to the community library
flows.description: User finalises an extracted persona and publishes it with a version note.

steps.desc: User names the persona (required) and edits any of the 7 dimension accordions.
User adds required keywords plus optional sub-domains, tone, complexity and audience metadata.
User selects Public (default) or Private, which saves as a draft instead.
User presses Publish in the persona footer.
Change-notes dialog asks what changed in this version; user may skip.
Persona row is written to the personas table under the owner's RLS policy.
Row is stored with version metadata for later history browsing.
On success the panel returns to My Personas showing the published entry.

flows.name: Discover and import a community persona
flows.description: User searches the shared library and loads someone else's persona into their session memory.

steps.desc: User searches personas by keyword or intent from the Browse page.
User refines with chip filters: domain, tone, complexity, provider and sort order.
Query hits the personas table; public rows are readable under RLS.
Matching personas render as result cards.
User opens a persona to inspect its dimensions.
Chosen persona is imported into the active session's memory.
Imported dimensions overwrite current memory and become active for refinement.

flows.name: Pin a persona so analysis cannot overwrite it
flows.description: User locks the persona (or a single dimension) against re-analysis.

steps.desc: User taps the pin icon; the AUTO badge indicates current mode.
Pin request carries the session id.
Marks the persona pinned and snapshots its current value.
Pinned state persists with the memory record.
Subsequent rebuilds skip pinned dimensions entirely, preserving them verbatim.
Refinement then reads the pinned persona in preference to the synthesized one.

flows.name: Hand-edit a memory dimension
flows.description: User directly rewrites one of the 7 dimensions in the Context tab.

steps.desc: User expands a dimension accordion, e.g. Tone & Style.
User edits the verbatim instruction text or adjusts metadata chips.
User presses Save.
Sends dimension id and new data.
Validates against the V4 schema and sanitizes the payload.
Change is persisted and the generation counter advances.

flows.name: Inject custom standing instructions
flows.description: User adds free-form rules that always accompany the persona.

steps.desc: User types a standing instruction such as 'Always use Python 3.11'.
User presses Save Extensions.
Stored alongside the 7 analyzed dimensions as injected_context.
Custom context is appended to every subsequent refinement.

flows.name: Rate a Gemini response
flows.description: User scores a conversation turn 1-5 stars to signal quality.

steps.desc: Checks whether the turn is eligible for rating before mounting UI.
Star control is injected beneath the response turn.
User picks a score from 1 to 5; values outside that range are rejected.
Rating is recorded against the turn index with a timestamp.
Written to sessionStorage for fast in-tab reads.
Mirrored into chrome.storage so ratings survive a page reload.
Ratings are attached to scraped turns and feed the next analysis pass.

flows.name: Configure an LLM provider and API key
flows.description: User connects a model so refinement and analysis can run.

steps.desc: From the 'No Model Connected' state the user taps Connect Model.
Worker calls chrome.runtime.openOptionsPage().
User picks one of Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic or OpenRouter.
User pastes an API key and adjusts temperature / max tokens.
Key is encrypted before it is written to disk.
Model config lands in pa_models and the active id in pa_active_model.
Broadcast so open Gemini tabs pick up the new configuration immediately.

flows.name: Create an account and sync to the cloud
flows.description: User authenticates so personas and prompts persist beyond the browser.

steps.desc: Vendored supabase.min.js is loaded, working within MV3 CSP limits.
Client initialises with persistSession true and detectSessionInUrl false.
User registers with email and password, or uses signInAnonymously() for a throwaway session.
A profile row is created for the new user.
Session is restored automatically on subsequent panel loads.
The user's personas and saved prompts become available under RLS.

flows.name: Save a prompt to the library
flows.description: User stores a raw prompt for later reuse or extraction.

steps.desc: From Saved Prompts the user taps + to open the Add Prompt form.
User enters a title and pastes the prompt body, or imports a file.
User presses Save Prompt in the footer.
Prompt is written to saved_prompts under the owner's RLS policy.
Panel returns to the Saved Prompts list showing the new entry.
A saved prompt can later be sent straight into persona extraction.

flows.name: Review and restore a persona version
flows.description: Author inspects earlier versions of their persona and rolls one back.

steps.desc: Author opens Version History from the Edit Persona page.
Version rows for the persona are fetched; the view is author-only.
Versions render with their change notes.
Author may export the persona as JSON via chrome.downloads.
Restoring a version returns to Edit Persona with those values loaded.

flows.name: Rebuild a persona from its source prompt
flows.description: User re-runs extraction against the original prompt after editing drifts.

steps.desc: User opens the fullscreen source prompt viewer from Edit Persona.
Original prompt is shown read-only for reference.
User presses Rebuild Persona.
Extraction re-runs against the stored source prompt.
Edit Persona is repopulated with freshly derived dimensions.

flows.name: Toggle split view
flows.description: User arranges the panel alongside Gemini.

steps.desc: User taps the split view control in the panel header.
Request is relayed to the active Gemini tab.
Observer switches the page into or out of iframe split layout.

flows.name: Switch theme across panel and page
flows.description: Theme choice propagates to the injected Gemini UI.

steps.desc: User toggles light or dark in the panel header.
Choice is stored under the themeMode key.
Observer also watches Gemini's own theme via initThemeObservation().
Theme changes are broadcast toward the side panel; the legacy listener was removed, so nothing consumes it today.
Injected UI restyles to match.

flows.name: Inspect and export diagnostic logs
flows.description: User troubleshoots by filtering and exporting logs.

steps.desc: User opens the Logs tab; a badge shows the current log count.
User filters to TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN or ERROR.
Matching entries render with their component prefix.
Export sends DOWNLOAD_FILE so the worker saves the log via chrome.downloads.
Clear empties the buffer.

flows.name: Harden the page at load
flows.description: Security and bridge scripts initialise before any page script runs.

steps.desc: runtime-security.js and extension-bridge.js load first, in the ISOLATED world.
Execution is confined to gemini.google.com.
Anti-debugging timing probe detects a paused debugger.
Per-session and per-instance keys plus an environment fingerprint are generated.
Bridge starts listening so MAIN-world modules can reach chrome.* APIs.
On extension reload the observer detects an invalid context and shows a reload notice.

verificationNotes: All 7 memory dimensions confirmed in memory/component-schemas.js (DIMENSION 1-7 headers) and the canonical order array at memory/memory-controller.js:48.
Message type strings were confirmed by matching both send sites (type: '...') and receive sites (.type === '...').

The bridge uses CustomEvents (pa-storage-request / pa-api-proxy-request), not window.postMessage, for MAIN->ISOLATED calls; postMessage with source 'ext-bridge' is used only for forwarding background messages back to MAIN.
Only RecentFocus is registered through AnalyzerRegistry (memory/index.js:62); UnifiedAnalyzer is invoked directly and produces all 7 dimensions in one call.
All 4 providers in model/model-registry.js are implemented in background.js request switches, matching the manifest host_permissions exactly.

KNOWN DEFECT: six badge ids are duplicated between the Context tab and the Edit Persona page (badge-context, badge-tone, badge-framework, badge-constraints, badge-format, badge-exemplar), so getElementById always resolves to the Context-tab copy.
KNOWN DEAD UI: #persona-page-detail is declared in sidepanel/index.html:582 but no navigateToPersonaPage('detail') call exists.
SECURITY NOTE: the Supabase anon key is committed at supabase/supabase-client.js:24. This is normal for anon keys protected by RLS; 14 CREATE POLICY statements were found across the two schema files.
supabase/supabase.min.js (162KB) is the vendored @supabase/supabase-js bundle and was intentionally excluded from symbol-level analysis.
